cards.card_text: Now God calls a group forward, and He doesn't hold back: "But come here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!" Then He asks who they think they're mocking, sneering at and sticking their tongues out at.
cards.verse_text: “But come here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!
